deviations.reason: Provisioning a service-principal workload token is not implemented; the Driver owns only its Agent runtime credential files, and this engine has no credential-gateway pairing to delegate to.
General Secret projections are not delivered on this engine; the Driver reads the selected Secret Driver's store only for the credentials it delivers itself.
A Backend-issued Codex account token is refused at admission; this Driver admits only runtime credentials, a staged Codex OAuth login or a provider key for a dedicated Codex Harness.

proof.tests: existing test evidence only; no tests executed by this audit
proof.live: no live deployment, model, network or host proof executed

docker.detail: Development-only Docker implementation; lacks production activation stages.

kubernetes.detail: Bundled production Kubernetes selection; requires explicit cluster configuration.

ssh.detail: Bundled compute-ssh selects occ/ssh in production; SSH is now on main.

containerd.detail: Production selection refuses a mutable image tag and requires the rootless engine to answer its preflight.

docker.detail: Creates or verifies one owned bridge network per Namespace.

kubernetes.detail: Creates or verifies tenant namespace, quotas, defaults and baseline network policy.

ssh.detail: Creates or verifies marker on host selected by exact Namespace name.

containerd.detail: Creates the Agent's internal and edge CNI networks inside the configured containerd namespace; both carry ownership labels.

docker.detail: Verifies network ownership, removes owned containers and exact network.

kubernetes.detail: Verifies ownership; retains externally managed namespace while removing owned infrastructure.

ssh.detail: Stops owned units, removes owned Namespace tree and runtime identities.

containerd.detail: Removes only containers, volumes and networks that carry this Driver's labels, and fails closed on a foreign resource.

docker.detail: Checks pinned driver, topology and configuration ownership before container preparation.

kubernetes.detail: Prepares exact topology and owned resources with immutable configuration snapshots.

ssh.detail: Writes immutable snapshot without changing current serving revision.

containerd.detail: Creates the Agent's storage, hands it to the workload user and starts the gateway container from the pinned image.

rows.name: Explicit activation and deactivation stages

docker.detail: No activation or deactivation methods; development prepare directly replaces gateway.

kubernetes.detail: Production stages verify exact workload readiness and update revision-aware Service routing.

ssh.detail: Activation switches snapshot and restarts gateway; deactivation only verifies revision because dedicated topology is unsupported.

containerd.detail: Activation and deactivation are distinct stages: the runtime is restarted on activation and stopped on deactivation.

rows.requirementDetail: Optional methods in the shared interface; production startup rejects a selected ComputeDriver without both activation stages.

rows.name: Stop exact revision without retiring it

docker.detail: Removes exact revision containers; leaves persisted revision outside Driver untouched; runtime tmpfs is lost.

kubernetes.detail: Stops routing and execution while retaining persistent claims.

ssh.detail: Stops unit and removes current/served pointers while retaining snapshots and Agent state.

containerd.detail: Stops exactly the revision's gateway container and keeps its storage for a later activation.

docker.detail: Removes exact revision Agent container; removes gateway only if its revision ID still matches.

kubernetes.detail: Retires owned workload and preserves replacement gateway and claims.

ssh.detail: Retires only exact snapshot; stops unit only when retired revision is current.

containerd.detail: Removes the predecessor's containers while the replacement keeps serving; storage is released separately.

docker.detail: One combined gateway/Harness container.

kubernetes.detail: Combined gateway/Harness Deployment, with Agent service identity.

ssh.detail: Supported topology: systemd-managed OpenClaw gateway.

containerd.detail: Runs the shared gateway runtime, which execs the embedded OpenClaw harness, inside the Agent's own network.

docker.detail: Separate gateway and exact-revision Codex container; transport retry limitation is listed separately.

kubernetes.detail: Separate exact-revision Codex Deployment or selected Sandbox workload.

ssh.detail: Explicitly rejects non-embedded OpenClaw; dedicated Codex deferred.

containerd.detail: A dedicated Codex harness runs as its own revision-scoped container beside its Agent's gateway, with its own token and readiness probe; the gateway reaches it by name on the Agent's plane.

docker.detail: Prepare removes prior gateway before creating replacement; no separate activation.

kubernetes.detail: Preparation preserves predecessor; activation performs gateway replacement and routing cutover.

ssh.detail: Prepare leaves current pointer and gateway untouched; activation switches and restarts.

containerd.detail: A prepared revision waits while the serving gateway keeps running; the runtime is replaced only on activation.

docker.detail: Replacement removes previous gateway first.

kubernetes.detail: Gateway uses one replica and Recreate; transient downtime and node-fencing limits remain.

ssh.detail: Activation restarts existing systemd unit, interrupting service.

containerd.detail: Replacement still needs a stop and start of the container process; there is no second engine to serve during the swap.

docker.detail: No Kubernetes existingNamespace adoption; own Docker network only.

kubernetes.detail: Explicit adoption verifies active namespace, ownership uniqueness and existing network policy before claiming.

ssh.detail: Rejects existingNamespace input.

containerd.detail: An existing network plane or volume is adopted only when its ownership labels match, and its stored labels are verified.

docker.detail: No Sandbox composition in Docker development implementation.

kubernetes.detail: Delegates provisioning to selected SandboxDriver with exact identity and workload requirements; waits for exact ready Pod.

ssh.detail: Explicitly rejects SandboxDriver selection.

containerd.detail: Rejects a paired Sandbox Driver: this engine has no Sandbox placement, so the dedicated Codex Harness runs as the Driver's own revision-scoped container and composition refuses the pairing.

docker.detail: Dispatches Namespace, start, stop and delete hooks; compensates failed preparation.

kubernetes.detail: Dispatches hooks around owned Namespace/workload lifecycle.

ssh.detail: Dispatches hooks around Namespace operations, activation and stop with failure compensation.

containerd.detail: Selected lifecycle Drivers run before and after the workload starts, and a failing hook prevents the runtime from starting.

docker.detail: Passes admitted plugin runtime to owning gateway or dedicated Agent.

kubernetes.detail: Projects plugin runtime and gates native readiness; configures required egress.

ssh.detail: Rejects revisions whose admitted plugin map is nonempty; an empty map does not trigger this check.

containerd.detail: The gateway runtime installs the admitted native plugin runtime before it execs the harness.

docker.detail: Separate Namespace bridges; no per-workload default-deny ingress/egress policy.

kubernetes.detail: Default-deny ingress/egress plus explicit DNS and approved gateway ingress rules; requires enforcing cluster.

ssh.detail: Separate Unix accounts, but shared host networking; operator owns network isolation.

containerd.detail: Each Namespace owns an internal and an edge CNI network, both kernel-enforced: the internal plane reaches nothing outside. An Installation that names an egress proxy gets the enforced topology - the proxy stands on both planes as the workloads' only route out, the workloads keep no egress of their own, and a relay on both planes publishes the gateway's port, which the no-egress plane cannot do itself. Without a proxy the workloads keep the edge plane and their egress is ungated.

rows.name: Explicit CPU/memory limits and tenant quotas

docker.detail: Container create sets bounded tmpfs, but no CPU/memory resource limits or tenant quota.

kubernetes.detail: Namespace ResourceQuota and LimitRange; explicit role-specific Pod resources.

ssh.detail: systemd unit has no CPU/memory quota directives.

containerd.detail: Explicit CPU quota and memory limits are applied to every container, and a delivery is admitted only when the Namespace's recorded limits leave room for it. The engine has no ResourceQuota object, so the tenant budget is an admission decision; requests are scheduler reservations and are carried unused.

docker.detail: Containers run as UID/GID 1000.

kubernetes.detail: Pod security context requires non-root UID/GID 1000.

ssh.detail: Per-Agent non-login Unix account; SSH control connection itself requires root.

containerd.detail: Workloads run as the image's unprivileged user with no-new-privileges, and storage is handed to that user.

docker.detail: Read-only rootfs, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges and bounded writable tmpfs.

kubernetes.detail: Restricted Pod context, read-only rootfs, no escalation and dropped capabilities; bounded emptyDir.

ssh.detail: Private Unix account, NoNewPrivileges and PrivateTmp; no container-equivalent read-only rootfs.

containerd.detail: Read-only root filesystem, every capability dropped, and a bounded tmpfs for scratch space.

docker.detail: Service-principal labels, but no projected workload token.

kubernetes.detail: Projects bounded audience-scoped ServiceAccount token read-only; disables ambient automount.

ssh.detail: Binds ServicePrincipal in ownership markers; no workload token projection.

containerd.detail: Runtime credential files are written for the workload and their status can be read; provisioning a service-principal workload token is not implemented by this Driver.

docker.detail: Optional resolver absent.

kubernetes.detail: Returns deterministic WSS address only when gateway routing is configured.

ssh.detail: Optional resolver absent; workspace-file API endpoint resolution unsupported.

containerd.detail: The published loopback port is read back from the running container and resolved to a private ws:// endpoint.

rows.name: Persist Agent state across runtime replacement

docker.detail: Writable state is ephemeral tmpfs; no persistent workspace contract.

kubernetes.detail: Private gateway RWO disk; embedded default workspace persists; dedicated RWX workspace is separate.

ssh.detail: Private home/state directories persist across stop and revision retirement.

containerd.detail: Named engine volumes hold Agent state across container replacement and are released only when the Agent is removed.

docker.detail: Separate ephemeral runtime homes; no shared volume mounts.

kubernetes.detail: Shared Agent-owned 40Gi RWX claim with directional mount permissions.

ssh.detail: Dedicated topology unsupported.

containerd.detail: The dedicated harness shares the Agent's workspace volume with its gateway through the same mount set.

docker.detail: No provisioning API; model credential supplied to development worker environment.

kubernetes.detail: Creates missing owned Secret groups; rejects conflicts and preserves matching existing values.

ssh.detail: Operator-owned Agent env file is the credential path; no runtime-credential API.

containerd.detail: Creates the Agent's owned gateway credential when it is missing, preserves the value it finds, refuses a file this Driver did not write, and removes it with the Agent.

rows.name: Deliver model credential only to executing Harness

docker.detail: Provider key reaches embedded gateway or dedicated Agent; dedicated gateway gets only transport.

kubernetes.detail: Agent harnessAuth selects an OCC Secret API key or account-owned token; only the model-executing workload receives it.

ssh.detail: Operator env supplies embedded workload credentials; no Driver-managed model credential path.

containerd.detail: The workload environment reaches the harness container alone; the gateway receives the transport endpoint and token instead, so a model credential never lands in the process that serves clients. A staged provider key for a dedicated Codex harness is delivered to that container as OPENAI_API_KEY and to nothing else; a staged OAuth login reaches its Codex home through a read-only seed.
containerd.testExecution: node --test tests/conformance/containerd-compute.test.mjs and the opt-in real engine lane (OCC_TEST_NERDCTL_REAL=1 with OPENAI_API_KEY)
containerd.liveProof: real model turn on the host's rootless containerd with an authorized provider key

docker.detail: prepareRevision does not consume ComputeRevisionContext or project OCC Secret bindings.

kubernetes.detail: Custom bindings are projected into gateway only; dedicated Codex receives an empty projection list. Built-in model/transport credentials use separate supported paths.

ssh.detail: Explicitly rejects OCC Secret bindings; operator env file is separate.

containerd.detail: The Driver reads the selected Secret Driver's store only for the credentials it delivers itself: a staged Codex OAuth login and, for a dedicated Codex Harness, its provider key. General OCC Secret projections are not delivered, which the Docker and SSH Drivers do not deliver either; a lifecycle owner contributes only opaque placeholders.

docker.detail: Only provider API-key environment supported in this implementation.

kubernetes.detail: Account-owned access-token Secret and workspace ID project only to dedicated Codex.

ssh.detail: Dedicated Codex unsupported.

containerd.detail: A Backend-issued Codex account token and its workspace identity are not delivered: this Driver admits only operator-managed runtime credentials, a staged Codex OAuth login or a provider key for a dedicated Codex Harness. The harness otherwise receives whatever the workload environment carries, which the platform limits to opaque placeholders.

rows.name: Persist dedicated transport authentication across retries

docker.detail: Source-inferred retry gap, unreproduced: a fresh token is generated each prepare, while a healthy existing Agent is reused; rebuilding only gateway can supply a different token.

kubernetes.detail: Both roles reference the same persisted Agent-owned transport Secret; initial provisioning generates transport bytes only if that group is absent. This source evidence does not prove every runtime retry or external rotation scenario.

ssh.detail: Dedicated transport unsupported.

containerd.detail: One transport token is generated on first provisioning, persisted as an Agent-owned credential file and presented by both roles, so a replacement keeps the authenticated channel its peer holds.

docker.detail: At the reviewed baseline, explicit trusted-proxy mode omitted the gateway credential. The current Driver supports password or trusted-proxy authentication only; see the current Driver reference.

kubernetes.detail: At the reviewed baseline, private routing verified explicit trusted-proxy settings. The current Driver always renders trusted-proxy authentication from Installation settings; see the current Driver reference.

ssh.detail: At the reviewed baseline, the trusted-proxy unit omitted its generated gateway credential file. The current Driver supports password or trusted-proxy authentication only; see the current Driver reference.

containerd.detail: Native trusted-proxy gateway authentication is honoured, with a managed password as the default.

docker.detail: No maintenanceIntervalMs declaration; event-driven lifecycle.

kubernetes.detail: No maintenanceIntervalMs declaration; Kubernetes controller handles workload reconciliation separately.

ssh.detail: No maintenanceIntervalMs declaration; systemd restart policy is distinct.

containerd.detail: Periodic active-runtime maintenance is not scheduled by this Driver.

docker.detail: Optional Docker Fluentd forwarding; Podman logging overlay remains unverified/unsupported on documented baseline.

kubernetes.detail: Labels workloads and supplies native admitted logging levels for collection.

ssh.detail: Native systemd stdout/stderr collected by journald.

containerd.detail: Container logs are read back from the engine with bounded output and exact ownership checks.

docker.detail: Accepts engine-resolved tags as well as digests for development.

kubernetes.detail: Production requires immutable SHA-256 image references.

ssh.detail: Host binary paths are operator-managed; no container image pinning.

containerd.detail: A production Installation must pin an immutable digest; a tag is refused at composition and by the configuration schema.
